categories.main_business_segments: Performance Food Group Company (PFGC) operates three primary business segments: Foodservice, Vistar, and Convenience. The Foodservice segment distributes a broad line of food and food-related products to independent and chain restaurants, as well as other institutional customers. Vistar specializes in distributing candy, snacks, beverages, and related items to vending, office coffee service, theater, retail, and hospitality channels. The Convenience segment is a leading distributor of consumer products, including food, beverages, tobacco, and general merchandise, to convenience stores and similar retail outlets across the U.S. and Canada.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: PFGC's core operations revolve around large-scale distribution, logistics, and supply chain management, supported by integrated information technology systems for order processing, warehouse management, and route optimization. The company leverages advanced procurement, inventory management, and transportation technologies, including on-board computers for fleet efficiency and telematics for safety and fuel management. Custom-cut meat and seafood processing is performed at select distribution centers, and the company utilizes 'pick and pack' capabilities and small parcel shipping for certain Vistar customers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: PFGC serves over 300,000 customer locations, including independent and chain restaurants, schools, healthcare facilities, business and industry sites, vending and office coffee service distributors, theaters, retailers, convenience stores, drug stores, mass merchants, grocery stores, and specialty retailers. No single customer accounts for more than 10% of consolidated net sales, reflecting a highly diversified customer base across the food-away-from-home and convenience retail industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates 144 distribution centers across North America, with 35 in the U.S. and 4 in Canada for the Convenience segment, and additional facilities for Foodservice and Vistar. PFGC's distribution network covers all major U.S. regions and parts of Canada, ensuring that most customers are within 200-450 miles of a distribution center. The company continues to expand its geographic footprint through acquisitions and organic growth.
categories.supply_chain_position: PFGC operates as a downstream distributor, sourcing products from a broad range of suppliers and delivering them to end customers in the foodservice and retail sectors. The company acts as an intermediary between manufacturers/producers and a diverse set of commercial customers, providing value-added services such as menu development, procurement expertise, and operational strategy.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding sales to independent customers (who generate higher margins), growing proprietary Performance Brands, pursuing strategic acquisitions (such as the pending Cheney Brothers transaction), and driving operational efficiencies through technology and network optimization. The company invests in digital transformation, supply chain innovation, and sustainability initiatives, including a goal to reduce Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by 30% by 2034. R&D is focused on process improvement, technology adoption (including AI), and product assortment enhancement.
categories.revenue_model: PFGC generates revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of food, beverages, tobacco, and related products. Revenue is recognized at the point of delivery to customers, with pricing determined by contract (fixed or percentage markup) or at the time of order. The company also receives promotional allowances from suppliers and offers value-added services to customers, but product sales remain the core revenue driver.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in a highly competitive industry with national, regional, and local distributors, including large players like Sysco and US Foods, as well as specialty and cooperative distributors. PFGC differentiates itself through scale, geographic reach, proprietary brands, and supply chain efficiency, but faces ongoing pressure from both larger and smaller competitors, as well as from purchasing cooperatives and group purchasing organizations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal 2024, PFGC reported net sales of $58.3 billion, gross profit of $6.6 billion, and net income of $435.9 million, with Adjusted EBITDA of $1.5 billion. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with net sales increasing 1.8% year-over-year and Adjusted EBITDA up 10.5%. PFGC continues to invest in acquisitions and capital projects, maintaining a significant scale in the food distribution industry.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: PFGC emphasizes its ability to offer a broad and deep product assortment, extensive geographic coverage, and value-added services such as menu development and procurement expertise. The company’s proprietary Performance Brands deliver higher margins and are positioned as a key differentiator. Customers benefit from PFGC’s scale, supply chain efficiency, and industry expertise, which enable competitive pricing, reliable delivery, and tailored solutions for diverse customer needs.
